description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Practiced Scrollsmith.
When Practiced Scrollsmith enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Daydream from exile by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Repeat from step 2.
